candidates.title: Trillion-Parameter MoE in a Box: Decoupling Memory Provisioning with High-Bandwidth Flash
candidates.reason: trillion-parameter MoEを単一nodeで低concurrency servingするためHBFとDRAMの容量・帯域を分離評価。HBF transportとstate bandwidthの独立なkneeを示しflash-backed MoE推論設計へ直接寄与。

candidates.title: Co-Optimizing Request Scheduling and KV Caching for Edge LLM Serving
candidates.reason: multinode edge LLM servingでblock-level KV cachingとrequest schedulingを共同最適化し、平均TTFTを最大54.02%削減。

candidates.title: DuoPIM: RRAM–DRAM Hybrid PIM Acceleration for Flexible-Batch LLM Decoding
candidates.reason: LLM decodeのFCをRRAM PIM、attentionをDRAM PIMへ割当てbatch-size依存性とmemory pressureを共同解消するheterogeneous PIM architecture。

candidates.title: Hydra: Phase-Aware Workload Characterization of LLM Inference across Edge SoC Generations, Backends, and Quantization Levels
candidates.reason: Transformersとllama.cppを共通schemaで計測し3世代edge SoC・13 LLM・5 formatのprefill/decode性能・memory traffic・energyを約107K recordでcharacterize。

candidates.title: FleetSieve: Decision-Critical Profiling for SLO-Aware LLM Fleet Configuration
candidates.reason: TP degreeとreplica数のprofilingをSLO-aware fleet allocationへの影響で選択し不要測定を削減。H100 gridでoracle decisionを維持しprofiling GPU-secondsを削減。
